about: Terms a first-time buyer does not know, each with the plain words to use instead (voice/RULES.md PLAIN-1, PLAIN-3; STANDARD.md P6). score.js fails a page that uses one in its prose. A page whose title or H1 names the term is about that term, so it is not checked for it. 'skip' lists URL prefixes where the readers know the term (investor pages). 'flags' is the regex flags; leave out 'i' for an acronym. Every hit was read on the live site on 2026-10-07 before the term went in. Dropped after that reading: 'grantee' (fired on people who got a roof grant), 'loss assessment' (the reader has to find that line on the policy by name), 'escrow', 'earnest money', 'due diligence' and 'reserve study' (the buyer meets these by name in the contract or has to ask for them by name).
